title: Visiting Artist Workshop: "The Alternative Firing Experience" with Vicente Garcia
source_quote: About the Instructor     Vicente Garcia is a multidisciplinary artist specializing in primitive and alternative firing methods, including smoke, saggar-fire, and raku.
